== Biography ==

The Eaglet is a sharp-eared creature who shares the misfortune of having tumbled into Alice's pool of tears. When the company assembled on the shore, it proved itself no admirer of the Dodo's elaborate speech, declaring plainly that it understood not half of such long words—and, what is more, doubted the Dodo did either. This bold observation brought a smile to the Eaglet's face, though it bent its head to hide the amusement while the other birds tittered audibly.
